patch_description: Add fixed CZ gates on the outer ring edges in Layer 3 (in addition to the existing CRX ring). This increases entangling power without introducing new trainable parameters, potentially improving expressivity and validation/test performance under the same budget of parameters. The CZ gates are placed on the same adjacent ring edges (0-1, 1-2, ..., 7-0) and respect adjacency constraints.
